article_content: Two renowned figures in the fashion world, Miuccia Prada and Catherine Martin, have joined forces to create an impressive wardrobe for Carey Mulligan's character in Baz Luhrmann's highly anticipated film, 'The Great Gatsby'. An exhibition showcasing some of the 40 exquisite dresses designed for the movie will be held at the Prada New York Epicenter until May 12th. The intricate, heavily beaded flapper dresses embody the glamour of the 1920s, though Prada notes that the design process was more about capturing the psychological depth of the characters rather than just the glamour. Martin, on the other hand, highlights the challenge of making the gowns live up to F. Scott Fitzgerald's vision, emphasizing that the film aims to convey the modernity and intensity of Fitzgerald's narrative rather than being a historical documentary. The exhibition launch attracted numerous celebrities, including Carey Mulligan, who wore the stunning frocks in her role as Daisy Buchanan, as well as notable figures like Alexa Chung, Isla Fisher, and Maggie Gyllenhaal. The event was a testament to the enduring allure of high fashion and the timeless appeal of 'The Great Gatsby'.

article_content: Bayern Munich is eager to extend the contract of their coach, Pep Guardiola, despite Chairman Karl-Heinz Rummenigge insisting there is no hurry. Guardiola's current contract with the Bavarians runs until 2016, but discussions about a renewal have not yet begun. Rummenigge does not anticipate Guardiola committing anytime soon, although he remains hopeful that the Catalan coach will continue to have a successful future with the German champions. 'He's the best coach Bayern Munich could have had,' Rummenigge stated. 'He's also a wonderful person and it's a great pleasure to work with him. I hope he stays with us for a long time. I know him well and understand that he doesn't like to renew his contract early or place much value in long-term agreements. I would only annoy him if I asked him now. I know when to initiate talks, and that won't be happening in the immediate future because he doesn't want that.', Bayern's Guardiola was vocal during their Bundesliga match against Hertha BSC Berlin on Saturday. The German club is optimistic that the manager will stay, despite not rushing the contract renewal. 'We still have time to discuss the issue,' Rummenigge added. Guardiola has already guided Bayern to victories in the UEFA Supercup, FIFA Club World Cup, Bundesliga, and DFB-Pokal. They are poised to defend the latter two titles this season, having secured a 10-point lead at the top of the Bundesliga with a 1-0 win over Hertha Berlin on Saturday. Additionally, they have advanced to the last 16 of the Champions League and are among the favorites to reach the final for the third time in four years.

article_content: By Daniel Martin. Updated on 23rd November 2011 at 10:25 PM. Alcohol use in Britain has surged over the past few decades, contrasting sharply with declines seen across the continent. Adults in the UK now consume 9% more alcohol than they did in 1980, placing Britain as the 11th highest consumer of alcohol in Europe, even though there has been a slight decrease in recent years. Conversely, alcohol intake has dropped significantly in other European countries during the same period: France saw a 37% decrease, Germany 32%, Spain 46%, and Italy 52%. A photograph shows a woman lying in the street after a night out, highlighting the issue of excessive drinking. Ireland, Finland, and Sweden were the only other Western European nations to experience an increase in alcohol consumption over the past 30 years, according to a report by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD). The study also revealed that Irish women have surpassed British women in obesity rates for the first time, making them the most obese in Europe. However, British men remain the most overweight, and British children are the third most obese, trailing only Greece and Italy. These statistics raise concerns about the impact of lifestyle choices on public health, contributing to rising rates of liver disease and diabetes. Last month, doctors from the Royal College of Physicians advised taking three alcohol-free days per week to safeguard liver health. The OECD study found that in 2009, individuals over the age of 15 in the UK consumed an average of 10.2 litres of pure alcohol, a 9% increase from 1980. Developing nations like India, China, Mexico, and Brazil have seen substantial increases in alcohol consumption. In Western Europe, only Finland (up 27%), Ireland (up 18%), and Sweden (up 10%) saw greater increases. There were notable decreases in the United States (down 15%), Australia (down 22%), and Canada (down 23%). Overall, alcohol consumption across the 40-member OECD bloc declined by 9%. The UK's alcohol consumption in 2009 ranked 11th in the OECD, with France leading at 12.3 litres annually, followed by Portugal and Austria. Britain's consumption exceeded that of Germany (9.7 litres), the United States (8.8 litres), and the OECD average (9.1 litres). However, the report noted a recent decline in alcohol consumption in the UK from a peak of over 11 litres in 2004. Mark Pearson, head of the social policy unit at the OECD, commented, 'Alcohol is an undeniable health problem for the UK—particularly binge drinking. Britain has a stronger drinking culture compared to the continent, and countries like France have implemented stricter taxation policies.' Health Secretary Andrew Lansley criticized Labour's introduction of 24-hour drinking, stating, 'These figures demonstrate just how reckless Labour were to unleash 24-hour drinking on our communities, leading to spiraling levels of alcohol consumption.' Additionally, smoking rates in the UK are below the European average, with 21.5% of adults smoking, a 20% decrease over the past decade. Greece has the highest smoking rate at 39.7%, an increase of 5.6% since 1999.

article_content: The inaugural Soccer Six Fest kicked off this afternoon at Mile End Stadium, drawing big names like former TOWIE star Amy Childs and Countdown's Rachel Riley. Billed as the world's largest celebrity football tournament, the event featured a diverse lineup of stars, including dancer Louie Spence, X Factor winner James Arthur, and singer Frankie Cocozza. Soccer Six, which began in 1995, has been held at various venues across the UK. This year marks the first-ever Soccer Six Fest, blending football with music. The event returned to Mile End Stadium, where the first Soccer Six match was played 19 years ago. Childs and Riley, among the celebrities present, showcased their football skills on the pitch in Tower Hamlets. Childs, a lifelong West Ham fan, and Riley, a devoted Manchester United supporter who once received a United shirt from Ryan Giggs live on Countdown, were enthusiastic participants. The festivities included pre-match warm-ups and friendly interactions with photographers, highlighting the event's lively atmosphere.

article_content: Laboratory work may not seem glamorous, but scientists in these isolated hubs have access to some of the most spectacular sights in nature. These images, compiled by GE Healthcare Life Sciences as part of an annual competition, reveal the beautiful views scientists see as they peer into the microscope. They highlight intricate patterns in tiny creatures such as mice and fruit flies that are also seen in various parts of the human body. Vanessa Auld from Canada took first place with this image of Drosophila's neuromuscular system in the microscopy category. Drosophila is a group of small flies, belonging to the family Drosophilidae, whose members are often called fruit flies. As well as being visually stunning, these images have helped cellular biologists from around the world uncover new treatments for diseases. The global imaging company has announced the winners of the competition as Vanessa Auld from Canada, Martin Barr from Ireland, and Graham Wright from Singapore. With over 23,000 votes cast by the public, their images will be used to light up Times Square in New York between 25-27 April. Pictured here are lung cancer cells with the blue stained areas showing DNA. Lung cancer is one of the most common and serious types of cancer. There are usually no signs or symptoms in the early stages. A microscopic close-up of fruit fly larvae. When fully grown, fruit flies are typically pale yellow to reddish brown to black, with red eyes. Many species have distinct black patterns on the wings and are about 2-4 millimeters long. Highlights include an image of a 'spine ganglion'. This is a nodule on a dorsal root of the spine that contains nerve cells that carry signals from the body's organs to the brain. Another image shows a microscopic close-up of fruit fly larvae. When fully grown, fruit flies are typically pale yellow to reddish brown to black, with red eyes. As well as showing the larvae, Vanessa Auld from Canada took first place with a stunning image of the neuromuscular system of a fruit fly. This year's competition attracted over 100 entries from scientists who are using either high-content analysis or high- and super-resolution microscopy techniques. Pictured here are human bronchial epithelial cells stained showing DNA in blue. Beautiful yet beastly: Trypanosoma brucei (pictured right) is a species of salivary parasite which causes African trypanosomiasis, also known as sleeping sickness. Lung adenocarcinoma (pictured left) is a form of lung cancer. Pictured here are neurons in the brain of a mouse. Images such as this could help researchers understand how conditions develop in illnesses such as Alzheimer's. Mouse spermatocyte is pictured here. These will give rise to sperm cells. This image by Graham Wright, Institute of Medical Biology, was a regional winner in the microscopy category. This year's competition attracted over 100 entries from scientists who are using either high-content analysis or high- and super-resolution microscopy techniques. Their images investigate at the cellular level a wide variety of diseases such as cancer, muscle disease, and the effects of parasitic infections. 'This year's three winning images are once again incredibly beautiful and compelling, reminding us of the cellular complexity behind disease and why the study of cells is so important,' said Eric Roman, general manager of Research and Applied Markets, GE Healthcare Life Sciences. 'We were delighted to receive so many outstanding entries to the competition, which highlights how cell imaging is helping scientists explore the universe of the cell and is advancing our understanding of so many life-threatening and life-limiting diseases.' The optic stalk of a fruit fly is seen here. The stalk is one of a pair of slender embryonic structures that becomes the optic nerve in the eye. Pictured is a spine ganglion. This is a nodule on a dorsal root of the spine that contains cell bodies of nerve cells (neurons) that carry signals from the body's organs.

article_content: Los Angeles (CNN) -- Taylor Swift has the opportunity to prolong her reign as the Academy of Country Music's Entertainer of the Year, but she faces stiff competition from four-time winner Kenny Chesney and fellow nominees Jason Aldean, Brad Paisley, and Blake Shelton. Chesney secured the most nominations with nine, followed by Aldean with six and Paisley with four. Swift is the most-nominated female solo artist, receiving three nods. Lady Antebellum leads the group nominations with five, while the Eli Young Band has three. First-time nominees include Grace Potter with three nominations, Aaron Lewis with two, and Thompson Square and Love and Theft each earning one. Blake Shelton will co-host the 47th Annual Academy of Country Music Awards with Reba McEntire, airing live on CBS from Las Vegas on April 1. Swift has been nominated for Entertainer of the Year for the third consecutive time, an award she won last year. She is also up for Female Vocalist of the Year for the fifth time and Video of the Year for 'Mean'. Chesney's dominance includes a nomination for Male Vocalist of the Year, his tenth, and two Album of the Year nods for 'Hemingway's Whiskey'. He also received double nominations for Single Record of the Year and Vocal Event of the Year for 'You and Tequila', a collaboration with Grace Potter, which is also up for Song of the Year. Aldean's six nominations include his second for Entertainer of the Year and Male Vocalist of the Year. His album 'My Kinda Party' is up for Album of the Year, while 'Don't You Wanna Stay', featuring Kelly Clarkson, is nominated in the Single Record and Vocal Event categories. Aldean's 'Tattoos On This Town' is competing for Video of the Year. Lady Antebellum's five nominations include Vocal Group of the Year, Album of the Year for 'Own The Night', and Song and Video of the Year for 'Just A Kiss'. Paisley received his fifth consecutive Entertainer of the Year nomination and eighth for Male Vocalist of the Year, which he has won five times since 2006. He is also nominated twice in the Vocal Event category for 'Old Alabama' with Alabama and 'Remind Me' with Carrie Underwood. Toby Keith's 'Red Solo Cup' earned three ACM nominations, including Video of the Year and a double nomination for Single Record of the Year. Potter's three nominations are all shared with Chesney for 'You And Tequila'. Eli Young Band's three nominations include Single Record and Song of the Year for 'Crazy Girl' and Vocal Group of the Year. CNN's Denise Quan contributed to this report.

Qaabooyinka hore u dhexe ee ayaa ka kooban Grace Potter siddeed ahaa, Aaron Lewis liddeed, iyo Thompson Square iyo Love and Theft kuwaas oo kala duwan saddex ahaa. Blake Shelton wuxuu isla soci doonaa 47ka Gaar ahaa ee Academy of Country Music ee sannadkii labaatan iyo tobnaan ee lagu soo xidhiidhow Reba McEntire, waxaana lagu yaabaa beegada CBS ka soo baxa Las Vegas 1 April. Swift wuxuu ka dib celinay gorgorka Gaar ahaa ee Sannadkii Saddexaad ee lagu soo xidhiidhow, gorgorka ayuu halkaas ka heshay siddeed. Waxaana ugu jecelay dhananka la isku daynaya siddeed ahaa, iyo Video ka Weyn ee 'Mean'. Chesney wuxuu ka jecel yahay gorgorka Dhananka la isku daynaya siddeed ahaa, iyo boqolka ugu badan ee Albumka Gaar ahaa ee 'Hemingway's Whiskey'. Waxaana uu helay qaabooyinka laba ahaa ee Single Record of the Year iyo Vocal Event of the Year ee 'You and Tequila', waxaana isku daynaya Grace Potter, waxayna ugu jecel tahay gorgorka Song of the Year. Aldean wuxuu ka dib celinay qaabooyinkiisii laba ahaa ee Entertainer of the Year iyo Male Vocalist of the Year. Albumkiisi 'My Kinda Party' wuxuu ugu jecel yahay Album of the Year, waxaana lagu soo xidhiidhow 'Don't You Wanna Stay', waxa lagu soo bandhigay Kelly Clarkson, waxayna lagu soo xidhiidhow goobo Single Record iyo Vocal Event. Aldean wuxuu ugu jecel yahay Video ka Weyn ee 'Tattoos On This Town'. Lady Antebellum wuxuu ka dib celinay qaabooyinkiisii shanaad ee Vocal Group of the Year, Album of the Year ee 'Own The Night', iyo Song iyo Video of the Year ee 'Just A Kiss'. Paisley wuxuu helay gorgorkiisii shanaad ee Entertainer of the Year iyo saddexga ahaa ee Male Vocalist of the Year, waxayna halkaas ka heshey siddeed. Waxaana ugu jecelay laba ahaa ee Vocal Event ee 'Old Alabama' iyo Alabama iyo 'Remind Me' iyo Carrie Underwood. Toby Keith wuxuu helay saddex ahaa ee ACM ee qaabooyinka 'Red Solo Cup', ka dib Video ka Weyn iyo qaabooyinka laba ahaa ee Single Record of the Year. Potter wuxuu ka dib celinay qaabooyinkiisii shanaad ee kuwo kala duwan Chesney ee 'You And Tequila'. Eli Young Band wuxuu ka dib celinay qaabooyinkiisii shanaad ee Single Record iyo Song of the Year ee 'Crazy Girl' iyo Vocal Group of the Year. CNN's Denise Quan wuxuu ka koobay xogtaan.
